reddit.title: Improved Audio Experience in Provincia: Soft Music Reloops
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the colony music system in Provincia. No more hard cuts at the loop! Our new long equal-power crossfade ensures a seamless transition between day, night, title, and combat beds. This means a smoother audio experience during your gameplay sessions. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
